item.title: Error in table(FEATS, NE) : all arguments must have the same length (RStudio)
item.description:
This is done in RStudio
I am trying to do multiple barplots, between my qualitative and discete variables. I have removed some NA's and replaced NA's through linear regression. For the removal of NA's I used:
`omit=(which(apply(is.na(Data), 1, sum)>=2))`
`Data=Data[-omit,]`
After that, i wrote this code
`barplot(prop.table(table(FEATS, NE)))` which is what am asked to do , FEATS=features, NE=NorthEast
and when I run the code, it give me this message "Error in table(FEATS, NE) : all arguments must have the same length"
Then I use the length() to see why is happening and there is a difference in the length, qualitative variables NE and COR(corner) have 117 lenght, while the others have 109.
How can I make them the same length?
